strings.name: Ed Sheeran
strings.summary: Born in Halifax and raised in Suffolk, Sheeran built an audience through guitar, loop-pedal performances and songwriting. After his 2011 debut +, ×, ÷ and collaborations took him to global touring stages. He faced several copyright suits; a US jury found no infringement in the 2023 Thinking Out Loud case. He released Play in 2025, ended his long Warner recording partnership in 2026 and continued performing.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: His songwriting, loop-pedal live performances and global tours connect folk expression with contemporary pop production.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Halifax, West Yorkshire, England, United Kingdom.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and beginnings
strings.facts.f2.value: Raised in Suffolk, learned guitar and began songwriting as a teenager before performing in London.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Solo performance and pop production
strings.highlights.h1.text: Builds guitar-and-loop-pedal live shows while bringing folk-style expression into contemporary pop production.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Global albums and touring
strings.highlights.h2.text: Albums including +, × and ÷ and continued touring connect his songwriting with international audiences.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Ended long Warner partnership
strings.timeline.t1.text: Announced departure after roughly fifteen years within Warner’s recording system, opening a new career phase.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Released Play
strings.timeline.t2.text: Introduced new collaborations and sounds into his studio-album sequence.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released Autumn Variations
strings.timeline.t3.text: Issued the album through Gingerbread Man after releasing Subtract earlier that year.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Won US copyright trial
strings.timeline.t4.text: A jury found Thinking Out Loud did not infringe the relevant Let’s Get It On copyright.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Released ÷
strings.timeline.t5.text: Included Shape of You and Castle on the Hill, broadening his international reach.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Released ×
strings.timeline.t6.text: His second album included Thinking Out Loud, later recognized with major Grammys.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Released debut album +
strings.timeline.t7.text: Songs including The A Team brought a UK breakthrough and growing international visibility.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Moved toward London performance career
strings.timeline.t8.text: Built audiences and industry connections through small shows, independent releases and frequent performances.
